title: Validate the Packet
story: Some messages are corrupt. Only packets with the right start and a temperature field can enter the dashboard.
lesson: 'text.startswith(prefix)' checks the beginning of a string. 'part in text' checks for a substring.
objective: Return True if packet starts with 'TEL,' AND includes 'TEMP=' anywhere; otherwise False.
hint: Combine packet.startswith('TEL,') with a substring check using 'and'.
